title: Settings, error states and launch audit
description: Wave 3. Area: src/features/game-settings/ (new) and error/empty states. Settings screen (motion, reset progress; sound once audio exists), offline/failed-to-load/unsupported states with retry and home. Launch audit: WCAG AA and keyboard play across all screens, mobile performance and bundle budget, CI green, production deploy verified. Size S. Result: merged in PR #18 (src/features/game-settings: sound/motion/colour settings, progress reset, /instellingen, /hoe-speel-je, app error/offline states; audit: axe WCAG 2.2 AA 0 violations, keyboard play end to end, Lighthouse mobile a11y 100 / perf 79-81).

title: Remove landed lap folders and fill the decision log
description: Process gap found when the owner asked how far threads followed the loop skills (2026-11-04): landed laps left documentation/jobs/temp_job_* folders on main (game-engine, game-card, game-content, game-audio, game-board, game-flow, installable-app + template leftovers feedback-hooks, orchestrator-parallel-laps), and only game-engine has a section in documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md. Per loop-backlog step 3 / onboarding-first-lap D4: add a ## <slug> section per landed lap from its DECISIONS.md, then remove the folders. Size XS. Result: merged in PR #20 (decision-log sections for 7 game laps + feedback-hooks; 11 landed lap folders removed).

title: Show wasted gains at the meter cap
description: Found by the balance lap: when a meter is at 100, positive effects on that meter are wasted but the card still shows +N, so players don't learn to adapt. Show a MAX/greyed gain on card effects that would push a meter past 100 (and maybe a subtle cap glow on the meter). Area: src/features/game-board/ (+ GameCard prop if needed). Fits with the game-feel lap. Size S. Result: merged in PR #16 (greyed MAX on capped effects, cap glow on full meters, shared CapBadge kit component).

title: Game feel: asymmetric juice and animations
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 3, after the game board. Area: src/features/game-juice/ (new) plus motion tokens. The design's asymmetric feedback: viral = screen shake, neon confetti, emoji burst, pulsing counter; ad = coins fly to the Inkomsten meter, slot-machine count-up, gold glow; news = dry slide, small shield at Reputatie, no particles. Card draw/play, gains/losses, win/loss animations. Full prefers-reduced-motion support (and the settings toggle when it exists). Size M. Result: merged in PR #16 (src/features/game-juice: viral shake/burst/emoji, ad coins to Inkomsten, dry news slide + shield, meter count-up, end-screen entrance; reduced motion drops particles; card images wired into the board).

title: Card imagery with license manifest and credits
description: Wave 2, after content (needs card ids). Area: public/cards/ (images), src/features/game-content/ image manifest, and a credits screen. A subagent sources one fitting image per card: Openverse or Wikimedia Commons (CC0/CC-BY) first, then Unsplash/Pexels under their API terms (credit, hotlinking and download tracking). Reject recognizable people or brands and unclear licenses. Manifest per image: card id, source URL, author, license, required credit text. Crop consistently for the card frame; responsive sizes, modern formats (AVIF/WebP), lazy loading. Credits shown in the game. Any API key is fetched server-side or at build time, never in code; ask the owner with a sign-up link and env var name. Size M. Result: merged in PR #13 (src/features/card-imagery: 67 WebP images, 33 CC0 / 34 CC BY 2.0, manifest + getCardImage, /credits page). Board wiring (one prop on GameCard) handed to the game-juice lap.

title: Balance pass from play-tests
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 4, after events and endings. A subagent plays many full games (scripted strategies: viral-spam, ad-spam, news-heavy, mixed) with the engine and in the browser; tune balance values in the content data so each strategy fails for the intended reason and the IPO is hard but reachable. Turn findings (balance, UX friction, missing content) into new backlog items. Size S, recurring after launch. Known from the content lap: good play takes ~63 turns, phase 3's 30-turn hold is half the run; the human player doesn't see hidden Toxicity, so the lookahead win rate is an upper bound. Found by the orchestrator's play-test of /spel (2026-11-04): a V/A/N/N/A rotation sat 39 turns in phase 1 at 59k/100k users with Inkomsten and Reputatie pinned at 100: gains above the cap are wasted and phase 1 is too slow for balanced play. Also stats.users can drop to 0 while the Gebruikers meter is mid-range (engine D1 stat model). Result: merged in PR #11 (phase 3 hold 30->12, phase 1 2,500 users/point, phase 4 cost -6 and rep loss x2.5; humanLike median 44 turns, ruleOfThumb 55, all win the IPO; one-sided strategies still lose as intended; 3/3 browser IPO wins on the preview). Follow-ups: wasted-gain indicator, users stat model.

title: Events, phase transitions and endings
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 3, after the game board. Area: src/features/game-flow/ (new): event modal with three options, phase transition screens (Zolderkamer, Scale-Up, Wereldmacht, Beursgang), the three game-over screens and the IPO victory, results screen with the end report (damage, misinformation, mental health), play again and home. Size M. The end report is derived from engine state (playedTypes, stats); see the engine README 'Not modelled yet'. Result: merged in PR #14 (src/features/game-flow: event modal with scaled effects, phase intro/transition screens, game-over and IPO screens, end report). Share button not built (proposed task).

title: Installable app and offline play
description: Owner-approved (Stop 1, 2026-11-04). Wave 3. Area: public/ (manifest exists) plus a service worker. Install to the home screen and offline play after the first visit (cache app shell, content and card images; update flow when a new version deploys). Verify install prompt on Android Chrome and add-to-home-screen on iOS Safari. Size S. Result: merged in PR #12 (vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0 + its required peer workbox-window 7.4.1, owner-approved; precache app shell + audio, cache-first /cards/*; update prompt in src/features/app-update; start_url /spel). Orchestrator verified offline reload of /spel on the preview. Real Android/iOS install not yet tested.

title: Audio with mute toggle
description: Owner-approved (Stop 1, 2026-11-04). Wave 3, after the game board; pairs with the game-feel lap. Area: src/features/game-audio/ (new) and public/audio/. Sound effects and music for the asymmetric juice (viral: rising synth, applause, bass-boosted pings; ad: ka-ching and coins; news: dull wooden click), a mute toggle on the board and in settings, muted until the first user gesture, respects the settings. Sources: free-licensed audio with the same license manifest as images (source, author, license, credit), and/or generated sounds via the owner's ElevenLabs access through Composio (owner offered it; generation happens at build time by an agent with that access, never with a key in the app; record the provenance in the manifest). Size M. Result: merged in PR #8 (service, 11 ElevenLabs sounds in one style, mute toggle) and PR #10 (board wiring, levelled loudness). Background music: not done (follow-up if wanted).

title: Playable game board (core loop)
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 2, after the rules engine and GameCard. Area: src/features/game-board/ (new) and a /spel route in src/pages/; the start screen's Start spel button links to it. Mobile-first portrait board: three meters, phase and milestone progress, the central phone feed, the 3-card draft; tap or drag a card into the feed (keyboard: arrow keys + Enter), meters animate, next draft. Card detail view, pause menu (resume, settings, quit). Game state in a hook over the engine; no game logic in components. Playwright play-test of full games at phone, tablet and desktop widths. Size M. Result: merged in PR #7 (src/features/game-board, /spel with GAME_CONTENT, compact GameCard, phase-scaled effects, minimal event and end dialogs, pause, keyboard and drag play).

title: Game content: cards, events and UI copy
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 2, after the rules engine (needs its content schema). Area: src/features/game-content/ (data files, new). Subagent-written Dutch content as data files, not in components: the card pool per type and phase (names, descriptions, flavor text, meter effects and toxicity values that tie into the engine's balance), event cards with three policy options each, phase intros, the three game-over texts and the IPO end report, and all UI copy (buttons, tutorial lines, errors, empty states). Tone: satirical, sharp, no real people or brands. Review for consistent tone and balance before it lands (simulate games with the engine). Size M. Engine ready: fill the schema in src/features/game-engine/types/gameContent.types.ts; content can model the engine README's 'Not modelled yet' items (competitor and fine events) as event cards. Result: merged in PR #9 (src/features/game-content: 54 cards, 13 events, phases and balance, endings, UI_COPY; seeded balance simulation). Run length ~63 turns for good play (phase 3 hold = half a run): for the balance pass.

title: Card frame, game tokens and GameCard kit component
description: Wave 1 (parallel). Area: src/shared/theme/tokens/ and src/components/common/GameCard/ (new). Add design tokens for the card frame (radius, border, image aspect), card-type colours for Viraal / Advertentie / Nieuws and event cards with an icon and label per type so colour is never the only signal, meter colours, and motion tokens (durations/easings, reduced-motion overrides). One reusable GameCard kit component: image (object-fit, focal point, fallback when missing, alt text), title, key stats (meter effects shown as +/- with icons), flavor text, type and rarity states, selected/disabled/focus states, 44px+ touch target, keyboard operable. Presentation only, no game logic. Must look right with portrait, landscape and missing images. WCAG AA. Size M. Result: merged in PR #6 (GameCard kit component in src/components/common/GameCard with GameCardGallery, game tokens for card frame, type and meter colours, card motion; 222 tests incl. WCAG AA contrast). No gallery route (D8); the board lap mounts the cards.

title: Game rules engine and content schema
description: Rules SSOT: documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md. Vision: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (Dutch, phone-first, no accounts). Wave 1 (parallel). Area: src/features/game-engine/ (new). Pure TypeScript services, no UI: game state, the three meters 0-100 (start 50), the 3-card draft (one Viraal, one Advertentie, one Nieuws), applying a played card, hidden Toxicity, passive costs and reputation decay, the three game overs, phases 1-4 with milestone goals and the IPO win, event triggers (milestone and Toxicity threshold) and the combo/penalty rules (Ad-Fatigue, Echo-Chamber, Journalistieke Droogte). Owns the content schema types (card, event, phase, balance values) and a small seed deck as test fixture; real content is a later lap. Seeded RNG so games are reproducible. TDD per testing rule. Size M. Result: merged in PR #5 (src/features/game-engine, public API @/features/game-engine/api, 47 tests, decisions D1-D9 in its README). Not modelled yet (see README): phase-2 competitors and ad-pressure complaints, phase-3 direct fines, end report.

title: Make the interface yours
description: Result: Dutch start screen and rename (PR #2); neon feed theme, dark by default, app icon (cursor and gold coin) and link-preview card (PR #3). Owner confirmed the card in a chat app.

title: Put your app online (Cloudflare hosting)
description: Get your app live on the internet with Cloudflare (free tier is fine). Your coding agent does the setup — just ask it to "do the hosting task". What you need ready: a Cloudflare account, your Supabase keys already in .env, and (optional) a domain name you own. How it works once set up depends on your git workflow mode (see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md § Mode behavior table, rows staging and production) — by default every pull request gets its own preview link and merging the pull request ships to production. One step happens in the Cloudflare website (connecting your repo); the agent tells you what must be set there and why, waits for you, and checks the result. Agent playbook + troubleshooting: documentation/DOC_CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS.md (see "Agent one-shot brief"). If you explicitly say this app does not use Cloudflare, the agent offers to delete that hosting code (there is then no preview link). Agent gate: .agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/onboarding.md § Shipped integrations and § Configuration tasks gate (Hosting). Result: Workers Builds connected; production https://clickbait-capital.tmi-5ba.workers.dev serves main, and per-branch previews (https://<branch>-clickbait-capital.tmi-5ba.workers.dev) build on every pull request (verified on PR #2). GitHub Actions CI had not run yet at that point.

title: Define app vision
description: Collaborate with the coding agent to fill documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (problem, persona, app role). Replace placeholder bullets with real prose and change Vision status from DRAFT to ACTIVE when complete. Agent gate: .agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/onboarding.md § App vision & goals gate. Result: vision ACTIVE (free online web game for anyone, no accounts); game rules saved as documentation/DOC_GAME_DESIGN.md.

title: Capture app errors to the database
description: Global window error and unhandledrejection handler, error boundary reporting, and the existing logError path, all writing through the deduplicating upsert from the signals backend task. Tag each error with the environment (local, staging, production). Depends on: Signals backend task. Result: merged in PR #28 (src/features/error-reporting; live on production).

title: Signals backend: error logs, feedback and bugs tables
description: Add supabase/migrations with error_logs (clustered by hash, upsert_error_log function), app_feedback and bugs tables, RLS, and a db:push-staging script, so the signal adapter in .agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/signal-adapter.md has data to read. Forks get this by default. Admin = a role claim in the user's auth app_metadata (never user_metadata, which users can edit); admins and local dev can read, signed-in users can insert their own rows. Test it on a scratch Postgres, then apply it to the project; with isolated staging, staging first and production after merge. Result: merged in PR #27 (tables, upsert_error_log, RLS; Google sign-in and production build verified; one shared Supabase project by default, D10).

title: Onboarding states requirements, not methods
description: Rewrite the onboarding gates and the seeded Supabase and hosting tasks so they state setup requirements (end state, why, how the agent verifies, who acts) instead of vendor click paths, and add the staging Supabase project requirement. Decisions: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § onboarding-requirements. Result: merged in PR #26 (onboarding.md states requirements; Supabase and hosting requirement tables; signals epic queued).

title: Run the loop skill evals against the v0.42.0 baseline
description: Deferred from the skill-loop rework (skill-loop D59) to save usage. Run the eval cases under .agents/skills/router/evals/ and .agents/skills/loop-*/evals/ (15 cases), once with the new skill and once with the v0.42.0 skills it replaced (baseline = commit a920c0d), using the skill-creator workflow or `claude plugin eval`. Report pass rates per skill, and fix the skills where the new version loses behavior. Context: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § skill-loop. Result: 45/45 graders passed on new skills vs 39/45 on v0.42.0 baseline (composer-2.5); 0 regressions.

title: Show the harness overview on the app's home page and README
description: Publish the designed harness flowchart as an app route (/harness) built from kit components and the bronze theme tokens, with a PNG preview (public/harness-overview.png). Show a welcome card on the home page so visitors on the preview URL and on a fresh first run see it, and put the image at the top of README.md so people arriving from GitHub or Google see it. Result: merged in PR #32 (src/features/harness-overview, route /harness, public/harness-overview.png).

title: Fix Google sign-in returning to the wrong site with a PKCE error
description: Seen on the production site after signing in with Google from a preview: 'PKCE code verifier not found in storage'. Supabase auth logs show the sign-in started on the preview origin, Supabase redirected to the Site URL (production) because the app's bare-origin redirect address did not match the '/**' allow-list pattern, and production then failed with bad_code_verifier. The app also exchanges the code twice (supabase-js does it during client init, then the callback hook again), which would show a false error even when sign-in works. Decisions: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § google-signin-return. Result: merged in PR #29 (0817eac, fix(auth): return Google sign-in to the app root and skip a redundant code exchange).

title: Orchestrator for parallel laps
description: An optional orchestrator role (skill) the owner talks to: it owns the backlog and task state, watches the app vision, runs several laps at once in separate threads, relays questions between threads and the owner, and verifies and merges their work. Backlog/state work moves out of the per-lap loop into it. With one task, the plain loop runs without it. Keep the instructions lean: name outcomes, not procedure.

title: Deny reading nested secrets files
description: Widen .claude/settings.json permissions.deny from root-only ./.env* and ./.dev.vars* to recursive **/ patterns so nested secrets (e.g. supabase/functions/.env) are never read or sent to the model provider; .env.example stays readable via a negated deny rule. From the Claude Code video-lessons review.

title: Replace architecture.md folder tree with pointer and folder meanings
description: The src/ tree in .claude/rules/architecture.md § Folder structure had drifted (listed routes/ store/ lib/ that do not exist, missed whitelisted api/ and shared/config/) and duplicated ARCHITECTURE.md. Replaced with a pointer to ls src/, projectStructure.config.cjs, pnpm validate:structure and ARCHITECTURE.md, keeping four one-line folder meanings the tools cannot express. From the Claude Code video-lessons review (option B, owner-approved).

title: Feedback hooks: lint after edit, type-check before turn end
description: Claude Code hooks replace remember-to-run instructions: a PostToolUse hook runs ESLint --fix on each edited .ts/.tsx file and returns remaining errors to the agent; a Stop hook runs type-check when TypeScript files changed and blocks the turn end once per failing state. Shared hook-input reader in scripts/hook-input.cjs; push-safety.md lint paragraph trimmed. From the Claude Code video-lessons review (owner picked both, Stop hook type-check only).

title: Context-cost audit: slim always-on rules
description: meta-audit-harness context-cost lens (R1-R9): moved Model A/B promote and PR procedures from git-workflow.md into loop-ship references, cut Related Rules footers (DOC_RULES_INDEX is SSOT), moved Windows-only shell text to documentation/DOC_WINDOWS_SHELL.md, and trimmed testing, agent-behavior, code-style and architecture to pointers. Always-on context about 17.6k to 14.5k tokens (-18%), no information lost (ledger in the lap folder). Follow-ups R10-R12 are separate backlog tasks. From the Claude Code video-lessons review.
